title: odontophyllum chrysanthum
intro: Odontophyllum chrysanthum, commonly known as Toothache Plant, is a tropical plant species that belongs to the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat toothaches, fever, and other inflammatory conditions due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Odontophyllum chrysanthum include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can help prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
